summary: Lague Airport (IATA: LCO, ICAO: FCBL) is a small airfield serving the town of Lague in the Republic of the Congo. Located in a rural area of the country, it primarily supports regional and charter flights connecting remote communities. The airport features a single runway and operates with basic infrastructure typical of small Congolese airfields.
faqs:
Q: What type of airport is Lague Airport?
A: Lague Airport is classified as a small airport with limited facilities, primarily serving regional and charter aviation needs in the Republic of the Congo.

Q: Are there commercial passenger flights to Lague?
A: Scheduled commercial service is limited; most flights operating to and from Lague are charter or private aircraft serving the local region.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: As a small airfield, Lague Airport offers basic infrastructure with minimal passenger amenities. Travelers should expect limited services and plan accordingly.

Q: What are the airport's coordinates?
A: Lague Airport is located at approximately -2.450 latitude and 14.533 longitude in the Republic of the Congo.
transport_tips: Ground transportation options at Lague Airport are limited, so arranging a vehicle in advance is highly recommended. Local taxis or pre-booked transfers are typically the most reliable ways to reach the town of Lague. Travelers should confirm pickup arrangements before arrival, as on-demand services may not be readily available.
local_tip: Bring cash in local currency (CFA franc) for any ground transport or services, as card payment facilities are uncommon in this part of the Republic of the Congo.
